DimensionsAspect.description: An aspect that defines basic object measurements: height, length width.

properties.name: Height
properties.description: Object's height/depth in meters.

properties.name: Length
properties.description: Object's length in meters.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Object's width/thickness in meters.

QuantityTakeoffAspect.description: An abstract aspect that contains detailed measurement of materials and labor needed to complete a construction project.

DoorAspect.description: An aspect that describes the door type.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Type of a door.

ElementOwnsDimensionsAspect.description: A relationship tieing the specialized quantity takeoff aspect with an element

ElementOwnsQuantityTakeOffAspect.description: Element may own one or more quantitytakeoffaspects

ElementOwnsDoorAspect.description: A relationship tieing the specialized quantity takeoff aspect with an element

ElementOwnsEnergyPerformanceAspect.description: A relationship tieing the specialized quantity takeoff aspect with an element

EnergyPerformanceAspect.description: An aspect that defines the overall energy efficiency rating of a building.

properties.name: Rating
properties.description: Energy performance rating defined as a number from 0 to 100.

ElementOwnsFoundationAspect.description: A relationship tieing the specialized quantity takeoff aspect with an element

FoundationAspect.description: An aspect that describes the type of structural foundation.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Type of a structural foundation.

ElementOwnsMaterialAspect.description: A relationship tieing the specialized quantity takeoff aspect with an element

MaterialAspect.description: An aspect that defines the basic properties of a material.

properties.name: Material
properties.description: Material name.

properties.name: MaterialDensity
properties.description: Material density described as kilogram per meter cubed.
properties.label: Material Density

properties.name: Weight
properties.description: Material weight in kilograms.

ElementOwnsPerimeterAspect.description: A relationship tieing the specialized quantity takeoff aspect with an element

properties.name: Perimeter
properties.description: Perimeter of the shape in meters.

PileAspect.description: An aspect that defines the depth of a vertical structural element of a deep foundation - pile.

properties.label: Embedment Depth

ElementOwnsPipeAspect.description: A relationship tieing the specialized quantity takeoff aspect with an element

properties.description: Diameter of a pipe in meters.

properties.name: Length
properties.description: Length of a pipe in meters.

properties.name: Schedule
properties.description: Schedule of a pipe. The schedule number on a pipe relates to the thickness of the wall on the pipe.

properties.name: Thickness
properties.description: Thickness of a pipe in meters.

properties.description: Usable surface area of the bottom side.

properties.name: LeftSideGrossArea
properties.description: Total surface area of the left side.

properties.name: LeftSideNetArea
properties.description: Usable surface area of the left side.

properties.name: RightSideGrossArea
properties.description: Total surface area of the right side.

properties.name: RightSideNetArea
properties.description: Usable surface area of the right side.

properties.name: TopGrossArea
properties.description: Total surface area of the top side.
properties.label: Top Gross Area

properties.name: TopNetArea
properties.description: Usable surface area of the top side.
properties.label: Top Net Area

ElementOwnsSlabAspect.description: A relationship tieing the specialized quantity takeoff aspect with an element
